description: Wave 1 organization identities and scoped relationships; no runtime grants or authority activation.
statements: CREATE TABLE core.organization_status (code text PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO core.organization_status VALUES ('DRAFT'),('ACTIVE'),('DISABLED'),('ARCHIVED')
CREATE TABLE core.actor_type (code text PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO core.actor_type VALUES ('FOUNDER'),('AI_AGENT'),('HUMAN'),('SERVICE_ACCOUNT'),('SYSTEM')

CREATE TABLE core.actor (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(reference) <> ''), status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' REFERENCES core.organization_status(code), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version > 0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, name text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(name)<>''), actor_type text NOT NULL REFERENCES core.actor_type(code), role text, organization_reference text, authentication_reference text, authority_level_reference text, UNIQUE(reference))

CREATE TABLE core.business (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(reference) <> ''), status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' REFERENCES core.organization_status(code), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version > 0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, name text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(name)<>''), type text, strategic_status text, default_currency text NOT NULL CHECK(default_currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'), operating_model text, active_since date, founder_actor_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.actor(id), UNIQUE(reference))
CREATE TABLE core.actor_business (business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), actor_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.actor(id), PRIMARY KEY(business_id,actor_id))
ALTER TABLE core.business ADD CONSTRAINT business_founder_membership FOREIGN KEY(id,founder_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

CREATE TABLE core.legal_entity (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(reference) <> ''), status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' REFERENCES core.organization_status(code), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version > 0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), legal_name text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(legal_name)<>''), registration_number text, jurisdiction text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(jurisdiction)<>''), registered_address text, tax_id text, legal_form text, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id))
CREATE TABLE core.venture_stage (code text PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO core.venture_stage VALUES ('UNSPECIFIED')

CREATE TABLE core.venture (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(reference) <> ''), status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' REFERENCES core.organization_status(code), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version > 0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), name text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(name)<>''), strategic_thesis text, stage text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNSPECIFIED' REFERENCES core.venture_stage(code), owner_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, allocated_capital numeric(20,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(allocated_capital>=0), currency text NOT NULL CHECK(currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'), success_criteria text, kill_criteria text, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,owner_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id))

CREATE TABLE core.agent (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(reference) <> ''), status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' REFERENCES core.organization_status(code), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version > 0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, actor_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES core.actor(id), domain text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(domain)<>''), instruction_version text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(instruction_version)<>''), permission_profile_id text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(permission_profile_id)<>''), UNIQUE(reference), UNIQUE(id,actor_id))

CREATE TABLE core.agent_business (agent_id uuid NOT NULL, actor_id uuid NOT NULL, business_id uuid NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(agent_id,business_id), FOREIGN KEY(agent_id,actor_id) REFERENCES core.agent(id,actor_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id))

CREATE TABLE core.business_market (business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), market_reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(market_reference)<>''), PRIMARY KEY(business_id,market_reference))

CREATE TABLE core.legal_entity_bank_reference (business_id uuid NOT NULL, legal_entity_id uuid NOT NULL, bank_reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(bank_reference)<>''), PRIMARY KEY(legal_entity_id,bank_reference), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,legal_entity_id) REFERENCES core.legal_entity(business_id,id))

CREATE TABLE audit.organization_history (object_type text NOT NULL, object_id uuid NOT NULL, version integer NOT NULL, recorded_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), database_actor text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, snapshot jsonb NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(object_type,object_id,version))
CREATE TRIGGER organization_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core.actor FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER organization_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON core.actor FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER organization_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core.business FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER organization_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON core.business FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER organization_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core.legal_entity FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER organization_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON core.legal_entity FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER organization_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core.venture FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER organization_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON core.venture FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER organization_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core.agent FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER organization_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON core.agent FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE FUNCTION audit.reject_history_mutation() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPEND_ONLY_HISTORY'; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER organization_history_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON audit.organization_history FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_history_mutation()
REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA core FROM PUBLIC
REVOKE ALL ON audit.organization_history FROM PUBLIC
